name: Beren's Peril
summary: Scourge loyal to Thule Ravenclaw gather in the hills southwest of Ambermill, threatening the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Hidden Threat in the Hills
sections.body: At Beren's Peril, a cave and mountain path lie high in the crags southwest of Ambermill, hidden from the main road. After the Third War, rogue Scourge undead fortified the refuge under the renegade necromancer Thule Ravenclaw. They refused to bow to the Dark Lady or flee north. Ravenclaw's regents, guardians, and drudgers gathered in secret to prepare an assault on the Forsaken base at the Sepulcher. Forsaken scouts uncovered them, and the quiet cliffs became a warzone. Horde fighters now move against the undead before they can attack.

faq.answer: Beren's Peril is a cave and hillside pass southwest of Ambermill in Silverpine Forest, between the central highway and the Ambermill side road.
Scourge undead loyal to Thule Ravenclaw occupy the cave, including Ravenclaw guardians, drudgers, and regents.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken care about this location?
faq.answer: Forsaken scouts found the undead gathering troops and arms for an assault on the Sepulcher. Shadow Priest Allister ordered preemptive strikes against them.
Thule Ravenclaw is a powerful necromancer in Silverpine Forest who controlled pockets of mindless, hostile Scourge. He used places such as Beren's Peril and Fenris Keep to menace the region.

angles.text: As an undead, you face a bitter reminder of the Scourge's lasting grip. Ravenclaw's minions threaten the Sepulcher, and Sylvanas's loyalists must destroy them swiftly and without mercy.
As Horde, you must secure Silverpine Forest's rugged paths and clear rogue undead from their lairs before they can sever supply lines between the Sepulcher and the southern territories.
